title: Insurance broker rebrands as UKALA partnership launches
summary:
Mint Insurance Brokers has rebranded under the James Hallam Insurance Brokers name following its 2023 acquisition. The move coincides with a new partnership with UKALA to provide client money protection options for letting agents.

The post Insurance broker rebrands as UKALA partnership launches appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Lender provides £2.8m for 12-home scheme in Warrenpoint
summary:
Assetz Capital has provided a £2.8 million development finance facility for the construction of 12 homes in Warrenpoint, County Down. The 15-month facility carries a loan-to-value ratio of 65.55% and will fund ground-up construction of detached and semi-detached properties.

The post Lender provides £2.8m for 12-home scheme in Warrenpoint appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Title insurance enables £156,000 bridging loan in 10 days
summary:
Bridging lender SDKA has completed a £156,000 loan in ten working days on a six-bedroom HMO in Prenton, Wirral, by using title indemnity insurance to bypass legal delays. The property had title issues including restrictive covenants from 1885.

The post Title insurance enables £156,000 bridging loan in 10 days appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Yorkshire agency and Birmingham law firm announce appointments
summary:
Dacre, Son & Hartley has appointed Emma Blaker as senior lettings manager as the North Yorkshire estate agency expands its lettings and property management operations. Meanwhile, law firm Hill Dickinson has appointed Ed Colreavy as a partner in its Birmingham real estate team.

The post Yorkshire agency and Birmingham law firm announce appointments appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Hawthorn Capital acquires Leeds lettings firm in expansion
summary:
Private investment firm Hawthorn Capital has purchased Leeds-based Dwell Estate & Letting Agents, adding to its growing portfolio of UK property services businesses. The acquisition gives Hawthorn an additional presence in Yorkshire, where it continues to pursue opportunities across estate agency, lettings and property management sectors.

The post Hawthorn Capital acquires Leeds lettings firm in expansion appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: EPC deadline faces implementation barriers, report warns
summary:
New research identifies major barriers to implementing the government's 2030 EPC requirements for rental properties. The TDS Charitable Foundation report highlights mistrust in the EPC system, confusion over support schemes, and difficulties accessing tradespeople as key obstacles facing landlords and tenants.

The post EPC deadline faces implementation barriers, report warns appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Rightmove launches agent feedback platform Agent Pulse
summary:
Rightmove has introduced Agent Pulse, a platform enabling estate and letting agents to participate in research, product testing, surveys and provide feedback on industry developments. The property portal said the initiative will allow agents to share views on issues including home moving reforms and proposed agent regulation changes.

The post Rightmove launches agent feedback platform Agent Pulse appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Ground rent cap and commonhold reforms enter Parliament
summary:
The UK Government has introduced legislation that will cap ground rents at £250 annually and transition most new flats to commonhold ownership, affecting an estimated five million leasehold properties across England and Wales. The Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill sets a ground rent ceiling taking effect in 2028, projected to reduce costs for up to one million leaseholders.

The post Ground rent cap and commonhold reforms enter Parliament appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Inflation reaches 3.6% as mortgage costs face upward pressure
summary:
UK inflation has risen to 3.6% in October, marking a 12-month high and increasing the likelihood of further interest rate rises that could impact mortgage affordability and housing market activity. The Consumer Prices Index data shows energy prices drove the increase, pushing inflation further from the Bank of England's 2% target.

The post Inflation reaches 3.6% as mortgage costs face upward pressure appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Second charge loan of £404k settles business tax debt
summary:
A £404,000 second charge facility has been arranged against a residential property in Hampshire to settle corporate tax liabilities and repay unsecured company debts. Inspired Lending structured the 12-month loan to allow the borrowers to raise capital whilst maintaining their existing first charge mortgage.
